title: 第10章  五行宗弟子
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
杜信轻哼了一声，霍嫣笑着上前：
“都跟我来吧。”
众人都跟上她，一起进入要塞里面。
一路上，一道道目光朝着谢莲心和柳如烟看去。
作为仙盟第一人的弟子，她们两个备受关注是再正常不过的事情了。
这驻守要塞的弟子几十年，有的甚至上百年没回过宗门，所以他们很多只听说过谢莲心和柳如烟，但没见过真人。
现在他们打量着这两个师妹。
柳如烟极美，是个绝色尤物，谢莲心也美，是个绝色美人胚子。只是谢莲心此刻年纪还小，还没完全长开呢，在许多人眼中还是个小丫头。自然是十八岁又楚楚可怜的柳如烟更讨人喜欢。
女的也就罢了，那些男修见了她几乎都移不开眼睛。
“那就是柳师妹啊，好美啊！”
“真的好漂亮啊！”
这样的话传入耳朵里，让柳如烟甚是得意。
霍嫣带着众人来到了住所。这要塞的条件自然不能跟宗门里面比的，每个人的房间都就是一间石室，石室里面也就简单的摆放了座椅和床榻。金丹期早来过了，筑基期的都是头一天来，才知道自己住这么简陋的地方。
柳如烟蹙起了眉头，但是她没有说话。
“什么啊？就让我们住这里啊？”说话的是红月峰峰主的女儿文婷。
这次来历练的筑基期就几个人，柳如烟、文婷、韩青、江浩，四个里面，除了一个江浩是普通弟子，其他的都是仙二代。
文婷一直娇生惯养，看着这么一间破石室简陋得不行，她对着霍嫣撒娇：“霍师姐啊，我们就住这里啊？这样太简陋了。”
霍嫣道：“要塞条件是这样的，忍忍就习惯了。”
文婷一听，扭头看向谢莲心：
“谢莲心，你说句话？”

她想让谢莲心出头，换地方住。
“看我做什么？这石室很好啊，我就要这间了，你们自己挑吧。”谢莲心说完径直朝着最近的石室走去了，她一进去，一挥手，那石室的门就关闭了。
文婷气得跺脚，这混蛋在玄天宗的时候目中无人，现在住这么简陋的地方，她都屁都不放一个。
文婷又看着柳如烟：“柳师妹……”
柳如烟心里嫌弃简陋的石室，但是她不能破坏自己的好形象，温言安抚道：“好了文师姐，我看着石室虽然简陋，但灵气充足的，忍一忍就好了，大家都一样，总不能搞特殊待遇吧。”
韩青本来也嫌弃，但听柳师妹也这么说了，立即就道：“柳师妹说得没错，大家都这样，搞特殊待遇可不行。柳师妹能住，我也能住。”
柳如烟冲着韩青温柔一笑，韩青面颊立即就红了。
霍嫣看着柳如烟对她生出一丝好感来，其余人见状，也心道：这位柳师妹果然如传言中一般温柔，是朵解语花呢。
————
十日之后。
谢莲心坐在塔楼的高处俯瞰着下方，远处的空地上，柳如烟被一群人簇拥着。
筑基期来要塞历练实际上要做的事情很少，毕竟修为这么低，能帮到什么呢？主要不过是过来长长见识，开开眼界的而已。
在熟悉了要塞之后，筑基期有许多的空闲时间。
谢莲心经常是一个人在石室里研究傀儡，计划怎么溜出去找自己母亲。而柳如烟总是朝着各个师兄师姐们请教，很快她就获得众人的喜欢。而对谢莲心，众人的印象，就变成了孤僻不讨喜了。
夜幕已经降临了，要塞的防御结界在夜色中泛着金色的光芒。忽地外围的城墙那里起了一阵骚动。许多人听到了动静跑到了最外围的城墙那边。
几个穿着五行宗弟子服饰的人在要塞外面，他们身上伤痕累累，个个看着都是重伤。为首的一人道：
“我们是五行宗弟子，到魔界执行任务遭遇了魔族，又碰上了空间风暴，这才流落至此，我师妹中毒现在已经情况非常的危急，还请诸位道友放我们入关。”
为首的那人身材高瘦，容貌颇为英俊，修为是大乘期。此刻他衣袍破烂，身上都是血污，一副大战后疲惫不堪的样子。他挥手间，五块有着五行宗标记的令牌飞向了要塞的守卫。
有人已经认出了他来，小声地跟旁边的人说：“好像是五行宗的孙铭师弟啊！”
“我认得他，是孙铭道友！”

孙铭旁边，一个高壮的男子抱着一个昏迷的少女，少女气息微弱至极，并且一看就是中毒极深，危在旦夕。
“昏迷的那个是五行宗的周师妹吗？”
“好像是。”
“这怎么办啊？她好像中毒很深啊。”
众人虽然认得，令牌也没错，但不敢贸然放他们进来。于是都看向了佳孟关的总领杜信。佳孟关一切事宜皆由杜信负责，严欢是来护送历练弟子的，现在早已经走了。
杜信蹙起眉头，正犹豫中，旁边传来一个温柔的声音：“杜师兄，快让他们进来吧，我看他们伤得好严重啊。”
柳如烟走近了几步，杜信道：“师妹，你有所不知，魔族狡诈，还深谙变化之术。”
“我们这么多人，杜师兄更是修为高深，难道还怕几个人吗？放他们进来后，仔细地检查，然后看紧他们就是了。”柳如烟说。
旁边的人听了点点头。
“柳师妹言之有理。”
“他们就几个人，就算是有奸细在里面，看紧了就是了。”
“杜师兄，不如放他们进来吧。”
众人都附和起柳如烟，柳如烟很享受这种感觉。虽然她是筑基期，但是大家都听她的。救了五行宗的人，日后五行宗总得给她一个面子吧？
杜信看着柳如烟美丽的脸庞，见柳如烟嫣然一笑，他被说动了，于是下令：“放他们进来吧！”
要塞的大阵是非常坚固的，全部开启的时候，魔神级别来了，一时半会儿都攻不破。
防御大阵能自动识别魔族和驻守此地的玄天宗弟子，魔族碰到了防御大阵，防御大阵会立即攻击，玄天宗弟子自动放行。如果是其他人，虽然不会攻击，但会被阻拦在外面。
就是说，其他人想要进入要塞，只能让防御大阵开个“门”。而驻守的修士进出，不需要特别开门，直接穿过大阵即可。
虽然大阵能识别魔族，但为了安全起见，每次驻守修士出去执行任务回来，都是要严格检查有没有被控制，还要被关禁闭一段时间来观察。
阵法师们听了杜信的命令，就要施术，让防御大阵
“不能让他们进来！”
content_en:
Du Xin snorted lightly, and Huo Yan stepped forward with a smile:
"Come all with me."
Everyone followed her and entered the fortress together.
Along the way, one after another looked at Xie Lianxin and Liu Ruyan.
As the disciples of the first person in the Immortal Alliance, it is normal for the two of them to attract much attention.
The disciples stationed at the fortress have not returned to the sect for decades, some even hundreds of years, so many of them have only heard of Xie Lianxin and Liu Ruyan, but have never seen real people.
Now they were looking at the two junior sisters.
Liu Ruyan is extremely beautiful, a stunning beauty, and Xie Lian also has a beautiful heart, a stunning beauty. It's just that Xie Lianxin is still young at the moment and hasn't fully grown yet. In the eyes of many people, she is still a little girl. Naturally, the eighteen-year-old and pitiful Liu Ruyan is more lovable.
It’s just a woman, the male cultivators could hardly take their eyes away when they saw her.
"That's Junior Sister Liu, so beautiful!"
"It's so beautiful!"
Such words reached his ears, making Liu Ruyan very proud.
Huo Yan led everyone to the residence. The conditions of this fortress cannot be compared with those in the sect. Everyone's room is just a stone room, and the stone room is simply equipped with seats and beds. The golden elixir stage has already come, and those who came to the foundation stage only realized that they live in such a simple place on the first day.
Liu Ruyan frowned, but she didn't speak.
"What? Just let us live here?" The speaker was Wen Ting, the daughter of the leader of Red Moon Peak.
There are only a few people in the foundation building stage who came to practice this time, Liu Ruyan, Wen Ting, Han Qing, and Jiang Hao. Among the four, except for one, Jiang Hao, who is an ordinary disciple, the others are second-generation immortals.
Wen Ting had always been pampered. Seeing that such a broken stone room was so crude, she acted coquettishly to Huo Yan: "Senior Sister Huo, are we going to live here? This is too crude."
Huo Yan said: "The conditions of the fortress are like this, so you can get used to it."
When Wen Ting heard this, she turned to look at Xie Lianxin:
"Xie Lianxin, can you say something?"
She wanted Xie Lianxin to get ahead and change her place to live.
"What do you want me to do? This stone room is very good. I want this one. You can choose yourselves." After Xie Lianxin said this, she walked straight towards the nearest stone room. As soon as she entered, she waved her hand and the door of the stone room was closed.
Wen Ting was so angry that she stamped her feet. This bastard was arrogant when she was in Xuantian Sect. Now she lives in such a simple place and she doesn't even give a shit.
Wen Ting looked at Liu Ruyan again: "Junior Sister Liu..."
Liu Ruyan disliked the simple stone room in her heart, but she could not destroy her good image. Wen Yan comforted her: "Okay, Senior Sister Wen, I see that although the stone room is simple, it is full of spiritual energy. I just need to be patient. We are all the same, so we can't get special treatment."
Han Qing originally disliked it, but after hearing Junior Sister Liu say the same thing, she immediately said: "Junior Sister Liu is right, everyone is like this, and it is not okay to get special treatment. If Junior Sister Liu can live here, so can I."
Liu Ruyan smiled gently at Han Qing, and Han Qing's cheeks immediately turned red.
Huo Yan looked at Liu Ruyan and had a good impression of her. When the others saw this, they also thought to themselves: This junior sister Liu is indeed as gentle as the rumors, and she is a flower that understands language.
————
Ten days later.
Xie Lianxin sat on the high point of the tower and looked down. In the open space in the distance, Liu Ruyan was surrounded by a group of people.
There are actually very few things to do in the fortress during the foundation building period. After all, with such a low cultivation level, what can it do to help? The main thing is just to come here to gain experience and open your eyes.
After getting familiar with the fortress, there is a lot of free time during the foundation building period.
Xie Lianxin often studied puppets alone in the stone room, planning how to sneak out to find her mother. Liu Ruyan always asked her senior brothers and sisters for advice, and she soon gained everyone's love. As for Xie Lianxin, everyone's impression became that she was withdrawn and unlovable.
Night has fallen, and the fortress's defense barrier is in the darkGlowing with golden light. Suddenly there was a commotion on the outer city wall. Many people heard the noise and ran to the outermost city wall.
Several people wearing the costumes of Five Elements Sect disciples were outside the fortress. Their bodies were covered in scars, and all of them looked seriously injured. The leader said:
"We are disciples of the Five Elements Sect. We went to the Demon Realm on a mission, encountered demons, and encountered a space storm, and that's why we ended up here. My junior sister was poisoned and is now in a very critical condition. Please allow all fellow Taoists to let us in."
The man at the head was tall and thin, quite handsome in appearance, and his cultivation was at the Mahayana stage. At this moment, his clothes were in tatters, his body was stained with blood, and he looked exhausted after the battle. As he waved his hand, five tokens with the Five Elements Sect's marks flew towards the guards of the fortress.
Someone had already recognized him and whispered to the person next to him: "It seems to be Junior Brother Sun Ming of the Five Elements Sect!"
"I recognize him, he is fellow Taoist Sun Ming!"
Next to Sun Ming, a tall and strong man was holding an unconscious girl. The girl's breath was extremely weak, and it looked like she was extremely poisoned and was in danger.
"Is the unconscious one Junior Sister Zhou from the Five Elements Sect?"
"It seems so."
"What should we do? She seems to be deeply poisoned."
Although everyone recognized it and the token was correct, they did not dare to let them in rashly. So they all looked at Du Xin, the commander-in-chief of Jiameng Pass. Du Xin is responsible for all matters at Jiameng Pass. Yan Huan came to escort the training disciples and has already left.
Du Xin frowned, and while hesitating, a gentle voice came from beside him: "Senior Brother Du, let them in quickly. I think they are seriously injured."
Liu Ruyan took a few steps closer, and Du Xin said, "Junior sister, you don't know something. The demons are cunning and well versed in the art of change."
"There are so many of us, and Senior Brother Du is even more advanced. Are we still afraid of a few people? After letting them in, check them carefully and then keep an eye on them." Liu Ruyan said.
The people next to him nodded.
"Junior sister Liu is right."
"There are only a few of them. Even if there are spies inside, just keep a close eye on them."
"Senior Brother Du, why not let them in?"
Everyone agreed with Liu Ruyan, and Liu Ruyan enjoyed this feeling very much. Although she is in the foundation building stage, everyone listens to her. After saving the person from the Five Elements Sect, the Five Elements Sect must give her some face in the future, right?
Du Xin looked at Liu Ruyan's beautiful face and saw Liu Ruyan smiling sweetly. He was moved and ordered: "Let them in!"
The fortress's formation is very strong. When it's all turned on, the demon level is coming, and it won't be able to break through for a while.
The defensive formation can automatically identify the demons and the Xuantian Sect disciples stationed here. If the demons encounter the defensive formation, the defensive formation will attack immediately, and the Xuantian Sect disciples will automatically let them go. If it is someone else, although they will not attack, they will be blocked outside.
In other words, if others want to enter the fortress, they can only ask the defense formation to open a "door". The monks stationed there do not need to open a special door to enter or exit, they can just go through the formation directly.
Although the formation can identify demons, for safety reasons, every time the stationed monks return from a mission, they must be strictly checked to see if they have been controlled, and they must be locked up for a period of time for observation.
After listening to Du Xin's order, the formation masters will cast spells to make the defensive formation
"Can't let them in!"
